files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
### Import
- Import a listening history from a CSV file, in the format of the export ([#1](https://codeberg.org/badscooter/music-stat/issues/1)). Disabled by default: see the README to enable it.

### Library
- New "Genres" part: every genre with its tracks, plays and ratings, the genres played more or less than their share of the library, and genres to tidy (similar names, genres with one or two tracks, tracks without genre).
- Ratings: "Your 5-star tracks" becomes "Your tops": 5-star tracks and favourites (heart), best rated first, up to 20.
- Ratings: new "Your flops", the tracks rated 1 or 2 stars, lowest rated first.

### Sharing
- Shared pages have a concert photo as background, and can show a nickname instead of your Nextcloud name (Settings → Sharing).
- The new "Genres" part can be shared: main genres, over- and under-played genres, genres to tidy.
- The shared ratings page shows the tops and the flops too, instead of the 5-star tracks.

### Security
- Import: disabled unless an administrator enables it; files limited to 5 MB and 50,000 rows, never stored; uploads limited per user and per hour.
